name: Bay County, MI
findings: Bay County has 313 nonprofit organizations. 141 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 113 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Bay County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Bay County list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 12 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Hobby and sports organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 16 hobby and sports organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 16 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do hobby and sports organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Arts and cultural organizations stand out for public events
observations.text: 5 arts and cultural organizations here list public events, compared with about 2 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do arts and cultural organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?
